name: christmas-disco-dancer
prompt: Looping animation. A pretty, stylish young woman with an eye-catching, one-of-a-kind look: a tall, glossy retro pompadour of pastel mint hair fading to silver tips, tiny gold hoop earrings, a dusting of freckles, rosy cheeks and a confident, playful smile. She wears normal-size retro cat-eye novelty glasses with glossy red frames; instead of see-through lenses, each lens shows a big printed cartoon eye with long lashes, and the cartoon pupils glance left and right and blink in a smooth loop. Her outfit is a fitted red velvet Christmas coat with fluffy white fur trim and a wide black belt with a big gold buckle encrusted with sapphires that sparkle and glow as she moves. She dances smoothly and gently: a soft shoulder shimmy, a slight side-to-side sway, and her hands rolling in small circles close to her body, all small, flowing movements. Behind her, on a vibrant blue background, Christmas ornaments, candy canes, wrapped gifts and snowflakes float and drift across the screen in bouncy rows, like the floating graphics of a 1990s dance-pop music video. Playful retro studio-portrait style, bright saturated colors, smooth seamless loop.
